interactive.label: Save Graph
interactive.tooltip: Save the current graph (nodes, connections, component choices and layout) to a JSON file.

interactive.label: Load Graph
interactive.tooltip: Load a graph, or an Easy Mode preset, from a JSON file. You can also drop the file on the window.

interactive.label: Save Preset
interactive.tooltip: Save the current graph under a name as an optical path preset for Easy Mode.

interactive.label: Save to MMFDB
interactive.tooltip: Persist the current graph and its simulation in MMFDB under a name you give.

interactive.label: Load from MMFDB
interactive.tooltip: Choose a previously saved simulation from MMFDB and load its graph.

interactive.label: Export
interactive.tooltip: Export the simulated instrument setting as a JSON file. Greyed until a simulation has been calculated.

interactive.tooltip: Add the component selected in the list above to the middle of the graph. Double-clicking a row does the same.

interactive.label: Reset to Default
interactive.tooltip: Restore the standard path: two lasers, a sample, a dichroic splitter, two filters and two detectors. Replaces the graph.

interactive.label: Arrange
interactive.tooltip: Lay out the nodes by optical signal flow and frame the complete graph.

interactive.label: Fit
interactive.tooltip: Frame the entire beam path without changing the saved node positions.

interactive.label: Delete Selected
interactive.tooltip: Delete the selected nodes and connections. Greyed while nothing is selected.

interactive.label: Load Catalogue
interactive.tooltip: Load the dye, transmission and detector spectra from the selected backend.

interactive.label: source_port
interactive.tooltip: Zero-based output-port index on the source node.

interactive.label: target_port
interactive.tooltip: Zero-based input-port index on the target node.

interactive.label: Connect Ports
interactive.tooltip: Create an optical connection from the chosen output port to the chosen input port; one source may feed each input.

interactive.tooltip: Remove the link selected in the list below. Greyed while none is selected. The Delete key does the same.
